assessor: RTS governed build assessment — Exhausted-AI Human Escalation Gate v1
rationale: K0 reduced equal-priority review load but still maps many high-impact or high-causal findings to HUMAN_NOW even when a discriminating probe, deterministic action, or bounded defer condition exists. K1 is a small repository-local gate that separates important/actionable from truly human-required and therefore reduces premature escalation without granting semantic or execution authority.

assets.notes: Reuse K0 materiality dimensions, separate adversarial views and explicit problem-solving paths.
Reuse bounded/explicit execution philosophy; K1 itself does not execute probes.

gaps: No current layer requires explicit exhaustion evidence before HUMAN_NOW.
No current layer distinguishes a high-priority finding with a remaining probe from a true human decision dead-end.
No current layer treats defensible decision, discriminating experiment and safe defer as three explicit escape routes from human escalation.

risks: A claimed experiment may be too vague to be genuinely discriminating.
Safe defer may be asserted without a bounded trigger or recheck condition.
Missing verification evidence may accidentally be treated as exhaustion.
Human counts may be reduced as a vanity metric instead of preserving material dead-ends.
